title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World Season 2 Unveils 5 Cast Members
content: The staff for the second television anime season based on Nana Mikoshiba 's The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ( Hyōken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu - Sekai Saikyō no Majutsushi de Aru Shōnen wa, Majutsu Gakuin ga Nyūgaku Suru ) light novel series announced five new cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nana Mikoshiba 's Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel announced five additional cast members for the second season on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Live-Action Quiztopia Series Unveils Trailer, Key Art
content: Netflix Japan revealed the main trailer and key art for Quiztopia , its eight-episode live-action series of Reiichi Sugimoto and Shinkichi Kato 's Kokumin Quiz ( National Quiz ) manga, on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Demon Slayer Failed Where Jujutsu Kaisen and My Hero Academia Won & It’s Not Even Close
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Demon Slayer manga! There’s no denying that Demon Slayer is one of the most popular anime and manga franchises of all time despite being a fairly new series.

title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center Manga Ends
content: Emi Ishikawa announced on X (formerly Twitter ) that Toshi Densetsu Kaitai Center: Parallel File ( Urban Myth Dissolution Center : parallelfile, the manga adaptation of Shueisha Game's Urban Myth Dissolution Center game, has ended in the December issue of Shueisha 's Ribon magazine on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 3 Major Isekai You Can Only Watch on HIDIVE
content: HIDIVE has earned its reputation as an anime streaming platform, and these three exclusive isekai titles prove it. Choosing an anime streaming platform and a genre can be overwhelming, especially in this modern era, where new streaming platforms and genres seem to emerge almost every now and then.

title: Drama Queen Manga Ends in 4 Chapters
content: Kuraku Ichikawa announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday that their Drama Queen manga will end in four chapters. MANGA Plus publishes the series in English and describes the story: Hate brings pain to the world. After saving the earth, aliens have taken up residence with the humans in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Trigun Anime Gets New Novel This Winter
content: The autumn issue of Shueisha 's Jump SQ. RISE magazine announced on Thursday that the Trigun franchise will get a new novel written in collaboration between series creator Yasuhiro Nightow and Trigun Stampede writer Takehiko Oxi titled Trigun Manuscript this winter.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Releases New English Dub for Two Legendary Shonen Jump Movies After 21 Years
content: The two classic Shonen Jump movies got their anticipated English dub release by Crunchyroll. Over the decades, Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has serialized several legendary manga series, most of which ended up getting their anime adaptations.
author: ComicBook

title: Television Producer/Distributor Sandy Frank Dies at 97
content: Frank was born on July 11, 1929. Frank started his career as a sales executive for Paramount Pictures in the late 1940s, then worked at Guild Films and NBC before becoming President of Worldwide Sales at Wrather Corporation. In 1964, he started his own television program syndication company Sandy Frank Program Sales.
author: ANN
